caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate glass decanter with a pointed, cone-shaped stopper. The decanter is primarily deep red in color with clear or white areas featuring decorative patterns. The body of the decanter is bulbous and gradually narrows into a long neck, which is topped by a flared and elaborately designed collar. The surface is decorated with alternating vertical panels of red and clear glass, and the central widest part displays a band of white, etched grapevine motifs, including leaves and grape clusters. The stopper is also deep red with similarly designed clear or white decorative panels and patterns. The decanter sits on a round, flat base that is also deep red. The background of the drawing is plain and light-colored, possibly beige or off-white, which contrasts with and highlights the colors of the decanter.
title: Decanter
